---
name: Opt out of the public log
about: Ask for your MCP server to stop being crawled
title: 'opt out: <server or package name>'
labels: optout
---

**Server or package name:**

That is all that is needed. No justification is required and you will not be asked for one.

It is honoured on the next crawl and the server's pages are removed from the site. Log entries already written remain in the append-only file, which is stated plainly rather than pretended otherwise.
